name: tung-sports
description: Tung Sports — Tennis, Golf, Bowling and Krishiv Kart in the browser from one games menu, with phones as motion controllers

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix games/bowling --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix games/krishiv-kart --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: node tools/tennis-test.mjs && node tools/golf-test.mjs && node tools/swing-test.mjs && node tools/net-test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:bowling && npm run test:kart
